variants.title: A · 纸艺彩绘木板
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished paired concept sheet for an existing Chinese fantasy match-3 card game. Two equally sized 16:9 screenshots stacked vertically in a single portrait sheet, edge to edge, a discreet separator, no exterior presentation margins. TOP: redesigned settings modal on a hanging wooden stage prop. BOTTOM: redesigned compendium category entrance with three tall separate hanging wooden boards. References 1 and 2 are existing in-game screenshots: preserve their paper-theater purple curtain, cardboard castle/cloud/star scenery, camera and overall screen compositions; REDESIGN THE WOOD BOARDS AND THEIR UI, not the whole game. The two screens must share one consistent new material and ornament system. Both use thin ropes visibly tied to two attachment points on each board, ropes extending to top of scene. Straight front view, production-quality hand-painted 2D game UI with deliberate readable spacing, no photorealism. Settings retains exact functional scope: heading 设置, top-right ×, row 全屏显示 with toggle at right, label 窗口分辨率, three equal resolution options 1280 × 720 / 1600 × 900 / 1920 × 1080, first selected; quiet note 画面按 16:9 等比缩放; separated bottom button 退出游戏. No added audio sliders, no save button or invented tabs. Compendium: three equal boards titled 卡牌 / 补给品 / 藏品, center illustrations respectively a fan of star-moon cards / three colorful potion flasks / a shield, jewel and small treasure chest, modest bottom descriptions 专属与通用卡牌 / 补给与使用效果 / 藏品与被动效果, small consistent 点击查看 affordance; bottom-right 返回 ticket. Wood should remain recognizable but not dominant, substantial quiet areas for native UI typography, comfortable contrast, restrained ornament; do not repeat original heavy orange gilded frame. Keep all important boards inside safe areas. Chinese labels crisp and correct.
Direction A: PAPER-PAINTED THEATER. Warm ivory painted thin plywood, softly scalloped silhouette and visible layered cut-paper beveled edges, narrow muted lavender painted border, tiny dusty gold star studs, matte gouache brushwork. Only tiny edge chips reveal pale wood, no prominent grain across text. Rope pale flax with clean small knots. A small lilac ribbon crest carries settings title. Muted plum text, cream inset controls, dusty purple selected resolution with ivory type, understated faded-rose exit ticket. Compendium boards use very restrained accent edging in dusty lavender, desaturated sage and faded rose, same ivory centers. Illustrations look like sophisticated layered painted theater cutouts. Airy, refined storybook, bright readable panels over dim purple scene. Thin frame, minimal filigree, excellent whitespace. This is a coherent new design, not a recolor of reference.

Direction B: MIDNIGHT STAR STAGE. Matte deep eggplant and indigo PAINTED WOOD, slim stepped theatre-proscenium bevel with narrow antique brass inlay, restrained crescent and four-point star detail, subtly visible brush marks and wood on bevel only. Ivory typography and pale gold secondary labels. Rope muted old gold, understated brass eyelets. Settings has centered star crest above its title, structured dark plum inset rows, lavender selected resolution with gold edge, quiet burgundy exit ticket. Compendium three dark wooden panels each with arched inner silhouette, icons as small luminous cream/gold painted paper emblems with restrained blue, green, burgundy accents, carefully controlled glow only around center illustrations, slim fine gold rules. Rich purple theatrical mood, clean generous whitespace, premium rather than ornate, no neon, no dense starfield behind text, no metal armor aesthetic.

Direction C: VINTAGE THEATRE PLAYBILL. Narrow matte walnut wooden frame with softly rounded simple rectangular corners, slim burgundy painted side rails, a large warm aged-ivory PAPER PLAYBILL neatly mounted inside each wooden hanging board using four tiny brass pins. No torn edges and no bulky carved frame. Wood visible as calm narrow brown border, paper takes 85 percent of the front face. Rope natural brown braided cord through iron-brown small eyelets. Settings title sits on burgundy ticket-shaped paper header; cocoa-black Chinese labels, fine printed hairlines, cream paper controls, burgundy active resolution with ivory text, burgundy outlined exit ticket at bottom. Compendium uses same wooden noticeboards with small burgundy chapter tags I / II / III above category headings, hand-painted vintage print illustrations, tiny engraved stars, clear playbill hierarchy, restrained ornamental printer flourishes. Tangible theater props, warm quiet scholarly charm, more geometric/orderly and less whimsical than reference. No photorealistic corkboard, no random scraps.
